title: Sunday · the tavern's back wall in rain
logline: The back of the tavern from the garage door: cedar shake, the bare bulb, the door the rent goes under, October rain. The jukebox not drawn; the reader hears it anyway.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the tavern's back wall from six feet: cedar shakes dark with rain, the bare bulb lit, the plain door, a downspout.

image.prompt: the back wall of a cedar-shake tavern in October rain with a bare lit bulb over a plain door and a downspout, seen from close, no words

panels.name: Wall

panels.composition: Tier 2: the bulb, close, rain streaking through its light.

image.prompt: a bare light bulb over a door with rain streaking through its light, no words

panels.name: Bulb

panels.composition: Tier 3: the six feet between the tavern's door and the garage's, the gravel, both doors, the rain. Held.

panels.name: Gap
